verdict.rationale: The pack documents no registrable outbound webhooks that Cekura sends to a subscriber when events occur. The send-calls endpoint is the reverse direction: an agent or its provider's post-call webhook POSTs into Cekura. The Retell integration polls by API instead of using webhooks, and cron-job failure alerts are not documented as HTTP callbacks, so none of these is an event-subscription webhook.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
